issues.feedback: The technical approach conflicts with the acceptance criteria and can select duplicate backends. Example: completer=`claude`, `workflow.qa_backend=codex` yields `[codex, codex]` with the proposed logic, so `claude` never runs. This also breaks criterion #3 because `upsert_acceptance_result` will overwrite same-backend entries. Define selection so two distinct backend families always run.

The claim that no prompt changes are needed is incorrect. `build_acceptance_prompt` includes full `state_json`; if first QA result is written/upserted before second prompt is built, second QA sees first verdict metadata (`acceptance_results`). To satisfy criterion #4, use a pre-QA state snapshot (or defer state mutation until both QAs finish).

`registry.opposite()` returns a bare backend name. The spec does not apply `resolve_backend_for_role(..., "qa")` to the opposite backend, so QA role model settings may be skipped. Clarify whether acceptance QA should use QA-role models or completer-role models, and enforce consistently for both backends.

After acceptance failure, planner feedback currently pulls only the first failing acceptance artifact (`latest_completion_feedback_context` uses first `!passed`). With multi-backend QA, other failing backend feedback may be dropped. Specify whether planner should receive all failing QA artifacts or explicitly only one.

Proposed independence test checks second artifact content for references to first QA, which is not a reliable contamination check. Instead, make the mock backend assert on the incoming prompt (fail if prior acceptance verdict data appears) and verify both QA invocations occur even when first fails.

Coverage does not include `workflow.qa_backend` / `--qa-backend` override interactions with multi-backend acceptance. Add conformance cases for override same-family/opposite-family to prevent duplicate backend execution and ensure `acceptance_results` has two distinct backend entries.

The summary says 'every registered backend' but out-of-scope says only two backends and no dynamic discovery. This is ambiguous because registry also contains model-injected backend specs. Reword to 'both supported backend families (claude and codex)'.
